items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: They tolerated my presence with my beanie, and then they graduated.

ctx.x: They seemed so old to me. They tolerated my presence with my beanie, and then they graduated. And so I decided I’ll form my own band. So it took me a year or two to round up the co-founders. I got Emerson Brown and Derry Hall. Derry Hall was a pianist and a guitarist. But as it turned out we needed a trombonist so he taught himself trombone. And we had Ron Jabaul of the Alpha Del house, he was the cornetist, Dave Barbour was at Theta Del, he was the pianist, and his only failing was that he had to read music. And…
